newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australian 10-yr bond in downward drift.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australian 10-yr bond in downward drift.

text.p: *The Australian 10-year bond futures contract drifted lower in after-hours trade in a further consolidative move from last Friday's 92.830 SYCOM peak.
*April housing finance due at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT).
The June Australian 10-year bond futures contract drifted lower in after-hours trade in a further consolidative move from last Friday's 92.830 SYCOM peak.
The contract ended SYCOM resting on psychological support at 92.750 and down from Tuesday's 92.795 pit close, although analysts expect a further firmer support level at 92.720.
The softer tone mirrored similar action in U.S. Treasuries in the absence of any key U.S. data until Thursday's release of retail sales for May.
Locally, housing finance for April is due at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT).
Median forecasts for housing finance centre on a chunky 12.0 percent increase after the 1.3 percent fall in March, according to a Reuters survey of economists.
Analysts said this expected rise largely reflected private data on commitments from the major banks which showed strong growth in April of around 15 percent.

Such a rise does not take into account last month's mortgage rate cuts which followed the official cash rate easing to 5.5 percent, although housing appears to be the only sign of strength in an otherwise patchy recovery.
